title: Pullback normalization for derived reindexing comparisons
statement: For every derived-data witness R of an isomorphism g:X→Y with l invertible on X and Y, there is a realization p of the completed pullback through the source reduction system, the system pullback and the target total limit such that the package assembled from R with its pullback field replaced by p (all other fields unchanged) satisfies the prescribed integral comparison pullback normalization with respect to the target Roos model of R.

source.place: Steps 1 and 5; normalized completed pullback realization.

proof.text: Apply the primitive quotient pullback-model existence to g, the source calculus podReindexCalculus and the target Roos model of R. Its realization, with its representative normalization, is the required p; the assembled package's PullbackNormalization is exactly that normalization.

proof_origin.place: Steps 1 and 5; normalized completed pullback realization.

from.place: Steps 1 and 5; normalized completed pullback realization.
